Knowledge base review
Preparing a reliable browser workflow

Start by opening the page and reading its current state. Identify the visible controls and record which account and document the task uses. Reuse a session while the workflow is active so that sign-in and navigation state remain available between commands.

Verify changes at the boundary

After editing a form, inspect the value the page retained. After saving, wait for a receipt or reload the record. A successful click means the input was delivered; the application still needs to confirm that the requested change persisted.

Recover from uncertain outcomes

If a command times out, read the current page before repeating a submission. The browser may have delivered the action before the client stopped waiting. Keep an explicit checkpoint for steps with lasting effects and resolve uncertain work before continuing.

Keep observations focused

Use a snapshot when the task depends on labels, values and accessible controls. A screenshot can help with visual content. Preserve enough context to act correctly and include a complete observation when navigation changes the underlying document.

Knowledge base review
Preparing a reliable browser workflow

Start by opening the page and reading its current state. Identify the visible controls and record which account and document the task uses. Reuse a session while the workflow is active so that sign-in and navigation state remain available between commands.

Verify changes at the boundary

After editing a form, inspect the value the page retained. After saving, wait for a receipt or reload the record. A successful click means the input was delivered; the application still needs to confirm that the requested change persisted.

Recover from uncertain outcomes

If a command times out, read the current page before repeating a submission. The browser may have delivered the action before the client stopped waiting. Keep an explicit checkpoint for steps with lasting effects and resolve uncertain work before continuing.

Keep observations focused

Use a snapshot when the task depends on labels, values and accessible controls. A screenshot can help with visual content. Preserve enough context to act correctly and include a complete observation when navigation changes the underlying document.

Knowledge base review
Preparing a reliable browser workflow

Start by opening the page and reading its current state. Identify the visible controls and record which account and document the task uses. Reuse a session while the workflow is active so that sign-in and navigation state remain available between commands.

Verify changes at the boundary

After editing a form, inspect the value the page retained. After saving, wait for a receipt or reload the record. A successful click means the input was delivered; the application still needs to confirm that the requested change persisted.

Recover from uncertain outcomes

If a command times out, read the current page before repeating a submission. The browser may have delivered the action before the client stopped waiting. Keep an explicit checkpoint for steps with lasting effects and resolve uncertain work before continuing.

Keep observations focused

Use a snapshot when the task depends on labels, values and accessible controls. A screenshot can help with visual content. Preserve enough context to act correctly and include a complete observation when navigation changes the underlying document.

Knowledge base review
Preparing a reliable browser workflow

Start by opening the page and reading its current state. Identify the visible controls and record which account and document the task uses. Reuse a session while the workflow is active so that sign-in and navigation state remain available between commands.

Verify changes at the boundary

After editing a form, inspect the value the page retained. After saving, wait for a receipt or reload the record. A successful click means the input was delivered; the application still needs to confirm that the requested change persisted.

Recover from uncertain outcomes

If a command times out, read the current page before repeating a submission. The browser may have delivered the action before the client stopped waiting. Keep an explicit checkpoint for steps with lasting effects and resolve uncertain work before continuing.

Keep observations focused

Use a snapshot when the task depends on labels, values and accessible controls. A screenshot can help with visual content. Preserve enough context to act correctly and include a complete observation when navigation changes the underlying document.

Preparing a reliable browser workflow

Start by opening the page and reading its current state. Identify the visible controls and record which account and document the task uses. Reuse a session while the workflow is active so that sign-in and navigation state remain available between commands.

Verify changes at the boundary

After editing a form, inspect the value the page retained. After saving, wait for a receipt or reload the record. A successful click means the input was delivered; the application still needs to confirm that the requested change persisted.

Recover from uncertain outcomes

If a command times out, read the current page before repeating a submission. The browser may have delivered the action before the client stopped waiting. Keep an explicit checkpoint for steps with lasting effects and resolve uncertain work before continuing.

Keep observations focused

Use a snapshot when the task depends on labels, values and accessible controls. A screenshot can help with visual content. Preserve enough context to act correctly and include a complete observation when navigation changes the underlying document.
